title: Grateful Dead Live at Pittsburgh Civic Arena on 1973-09-24

ai_review.summary: Tight, horn‑enhanced show with standout Eyes of the World and Weather Report Suite; matrix mix is generally good though a bit muddy during the SSD.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised as tight and energetic, highlighted by an inspired Eyes of the World featuring prominent horns, a solid Weather Report Suite, and a lively Let It Grow. The matrix recording captures the band well with an excellent overall mix, but listeners note occasional muddiness on the final segment of the show.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give high marks (4‑5 stars) and describe a strong musical performance; recording is noted as good with only minor sound issues, supporting a solid combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and well‑balanced mix; occasional mudding during the final SSD segment, but overall pleasant listening experience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth set with horns adding a mellow texture, especially on Eyes of the World and Let It Grow; overall tight pacing despite a brief muddy moment at the end.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly noted for commanding playing, quick re‑entries, and strong guitar tone throughout the set.
band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for grabbing the lead early, sounding great with the horn section, and delivering solid bass work from the start.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's piano is highlighted during the Weather Report Suite, providing a solid keyboard foundation.
